purpose: Agent-directed recursive improvement of kernels and experiment selection toward the immutable 3x goal

authority.objective: docs/threefold-target.json; hash plus embedded snapshot frozen at init
authority.gpu_coordinator: results/rsi/gpu-lease.json; shared across all ledgers on this physical GPU
authority.role_identity: CLI actor strings are coordination records, not authenticated identities. Root must invoke genuinely separate agents for independent review.
authority.filesystem_trust: Local files and executors are trusted to attest truthfully; hashes detect later changes, not fabricated evidence or omitted dependencies.
authority.runtime_contract: serving/benchmark-contract.json hash frozen at ledger initialization; expected image digest extracted once and checked against frozen contract

supervisor: audits evidence and actual process handles
planner: proposes falsifiable hypothesis and ROI prior
freezes candidate, dependency bundle, suite and holdouts
implementer: does not modify incumbent or gates
critic: independently reviews baseline isolation, dependency completeness, precision and experiment design
executor: runs pinned harness with runtime deadline
records raw samples, structured correctness and environment
verifies actual process termination before releasing lease
validator: different identity from author and executor
verifies source and full-suite holdout evidence
method_reviewer: reviews changes to planner/ranking/measurement separately from kernel changes
cannot weaken immutable goal or promotion gates

revision_policy: Plans are immutable. Changed source invalidates review and evidence. Record rejection and create a new experiment ID with fresh holdouts; never overwrite prior outcomes.

local_gate.shape_coverage: exact frozen primary+regression suite, no duplicates
local_gate.seeds: all preregistered holdout seeds, minimum two, distinct from screening and previous ledger runs
local_gate.statistics: recomputed from finite positive equal-length even raw pairs using hashed benchmarks/measurement.py; reported CIs ignored
local_gate.noninferiority: every shape lower bootstrap bound >=1/1.02 in every holdout
local_gate.gain: at least one frozen primary shape lower bootstrap bound >1.02 in every holdout
local_gate.correctness: report-hash-bound reference, eager empty-local, captured empty-local, precision assertions and positive case count
local_gate.provenance: candidate/baseline adapter hashes, complete transitive bundle snapshot, baseline source must match immutable anchor, plan hash, environment fingerprint, unique independent session IDs
local_gate.primary_aggregate: each holdout primary geometric-mean point speedup >1.02 AND geometric mean of marginal lower bounds >1.0; latter is a conservative screening statistic, not a joint 95% confidence interval
local_gate.environment: Exact frozen container sha256 digest; GPU UUID, driver, Torch and CUDA must be identical across all holdout sessions. Session IDs must remain distinct.
local_gate.incumbent_replacement: Fail closed when a different local incumbent already exists. Fixed-anchor success alone cannot replace it; paired candidate-versus-current-incumbent evidence contract is not yet implemented.

goal_gate.local_promotion: updates ledger incumbent only; no source patch application and no full-goal completion
goal_gate.threefold: fixed baseline comparison over original benchmark, no subset cherry-picking
goal_gate.serving: full 8-H200 output agreement, TTFT and throughput/interactivity curve still required; not currently automated or available on one H200

budget_and_lease.admission: reserve max_run_minutes*hourly_rate before starting; deny insufficient remaining budget
budget_and_lease.accounting: elapsed lease walltime, not provider billing; idle node costs excluded
budget_and_lease.enforcement: ledger admission and exclusive ownership only. Executor must enforce process-group/container deadline externally. Ledger does not execute or kill commands.
budget_and_lease.expiry: deadline never auto-releases GPU; inspect actual live handle, finish with terminal proof
budget_and_lease.crash: Do not infer termination from stale files or deadline expiry. After verifying actual process termination, executor may abort with owned token, terminal handle proof and reason; abort rejects and releases/account resources even if artifacts changed. Lost token/coordinator corruption requires supervisor reconciliation under locks.
budget_and_lease.scope: all executors must use the same canonical GPU coordinator; bypassing ledger is outside enforcement

rsi_loops.kernel: profile -> hypothesis -> isolated implementation -> independent review -> measure -> validate -> local promotion/rejection -> rerank
rsi_loops.optimizer_method: observe experiment outcomes -> propose ranking/search/harness change -> independent review -> frozen portfolio A/B -> validation; promotion intentionally unavailable until evaluator implemented

method_trial_contract.status: specified_not_implemented; optimizer_method validate/promote deliberately fails closed
frozen_before_exposure: equal GPU-time and agent-token budgets for control and treatment
method_trial_contract.metric: validated log-speedup delivered per GPU-dollar and per agent-token, including failed candidates, compile costs and zero-gain trials
controls: full attempt ledger, no omitted failures
baseline method snapshot plus proposed method snapshot
method_trial_contract.decision: independent reviewer requires portfolio-level improvement and no weakened gates; one faster kernel does not prove a better optimizer

ranking.priors: ROI ranges are labeled engineering_prior, never reported as measured speedups
ranking.update: retain negative outcomes; rerank after each completed experiment using gain, uncertainty, cost and measured bottleneck share
ranking.selection: prioritize information gathering when hardware bottleneck unknown; avoid repeated unchanged sweeps
ranking.serving_translation: unknown until component share measured; use Amdahl rather than multiplying independent estimates

legacy: observe imports existing artifact hashes as observational only. Legacy results cannot transition through review, validation, or promotion.

versioning.v1: Existing v1 remains readable and observational. Execution/validation/promotion cannot acquire image provenance retroactively; initialize a distinct v2 ledger, register proposals and obtain fresh review before running. Do not overwrite or silently migrate v1 history.
